title: Build nationwide district climate sampling registry

acceptance.text: A reproducible, provenance-recorded registry contains one newly derived and geometry-validated interior point for each of Bangladesh's 64 districts, without downloading weather observations.
acceptance.evidence: Generated 64 fresh point-on-surface rows from pinned BGD-ADM2-16705992 geometry. The offline checker verified 64 unique IDs, complete names/coordinates, valid WGS84 ranges, 64 strict assigned-district interiors, unique containment, pinned source checksum and byte-reproducible outputs; separate runtime containment resolved 64/64.
